BiblicalUsage: Isaiah uses this word once, for a city left in ruins: in the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction. It is the picture of a place emptied out, its gates broken, nothing left standing to guard it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a ruined city preaches what a full one will not: that no wall or gate keeps a people safe when they have turned from the Lord.
